{{Quote|Wait don't shoot! I'm not the commander, he's the commander!|The OOM command droid|<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>}}
This '''OOM command battle droid''' was present on [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] during the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. He linked all ships functions to Bane's wrist gauntlet. When the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived on the bridge, the droid panicked and claimed that the battle droid next to him was the commander. After that droid was shot down, the clones shot the commander.
